notes.title: Devlog: #5 Major Release Prep – The Road to the End.
notes.notes:
[p][/p][p][b]Yo, Midgets.[/b][/p][p]We’ve cooked up a massive patch for the demo — it’s fucking huge, so let’s cut to the chase:[/p][list][*][p]We got rid of the salty bot sprint — now they actually [b]walk[/b] instead of blindly charging at the player.[/p][/*][*][p]Their brains got an upgrade — the dumbasses can now [b]act as a squad[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]The intro level got polished — now it oozes style, detail, and all that other junk.[/p][/*][*][p]Graphics got juiced — custom GI, tone mapper, and a whole bunch of other useful crap reworked.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][b]Release Date[/b][/p][p]Now that the demo’s updated on Steam…[/p][p][b]We’re ready to announce the official Steam release of DEN PAIN: August 21, 2025.[/b]
And yes — the price will be [b]150₽[/b], with a [b]10% launch discount.[/b][/p][hr][/hr][p][b]It’s CHINAZIS time, baby![/b][/p][p]On August 21, we’re dropping [b]Chapter One[/b] of DEN PAIN, where you take on the role of a floor scrubber — exiled, fired, and fucked.[/p][p]Your mission: make it to the office, grab your final paycheck, and try not to die.[/p][hr][/hr][p]You’ll find yourself in:[/p][p][b]DEN’S CRIB[/b] — the very [b]lair of pain[/b], where you can:[/p][list][*][p]Watch TV to [b]boost damage[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Drink [b]Brepcy[/b] to increase max HP[/p][/*][*][p]Smoke cigs — gain HP but with a twist, there’s a chance of sudden death[/p][/*][*][p]Sleep — to experience and overcome [b]nightmares[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Call a cab outside to move to the next chapter[/p][/*][/list][p]Plus, a couple of [b]full-scale levels[/b] with:[/p][list][*][p]Cutscenes, cursed ads, memes, and more unfiltered madness.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][b]What we’re working on now:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Our programmer Arkasha is developing an [b]advanced dismemberment system[/b] a la [b]Dead Island 2[/b] — the goal is total brain-blowing realism, and it’s working.[/p][/*][*][p]Still building out [b]Den’s apartment[/b] — interactables, immersion, and more chaos.[/p][/*][*][p]Finishing the remaining levels.[/p][/*][*][p]Squashing bugs as they appear.[/p][/*][*][p]Building the game’s official [b]website[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Cooking up content for [b]Toxic Social Club[/b] — subscribe here:[/p][/*][/list][p]          [url="https://toxicdev.ru/socialclub/index.php"]https://toxicdev.ru/socialclub/index.php[/url]
          to support our game development.[/p][hr][/hr][p][b]What’s next:[/b][/p][p]If the game [b]hits our minimum sales goal[/b], we’ll keep this party going and drop [b]Chapter Two[/b] soon after. But for now, brace yourselves and crawl forward with lips pursed.[/p][hr][/hr][p][b]Questions? Hit us up:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Tech issues (lags, bugs, broken junk): [b]support@toxicdev.ru[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Partnerships (keys, biz stuff): [b]partnership@toxicdev.ru[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Media, social collabs: [b]press@toxicdev.ru[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Support our devs here:[/p][/*][/list][p]      [url="https://toxicdev.ru/socialclub/index.php"]https://toxicdev.ru/socialclub/index.php[/url][/p][list][*][p]Follow us on Telegram:[/p][/*][/list][p]      [url="https://t.me/TOXICDEVofficial"]https://t.me/TOXICDEVofficial[/url][/p][hr][/hr][p][b]Conclusion[/b][/p][p][b]August 21[/b], midgets — get your wallets ready.[/p][p]— [b]Toxic Developer[/b][/p]

notes.title: Devlog #2: Preparing for the Demo Release
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello, Dwarves.[/h1]

Today we’ve sent the demo off for Steam review, who knows if we’ll make it into the game festival and rack up wishlists, we’ll see, but for now catch a batch of new screenshots from the demo:

[i]Shooting in that very mobster’s sauna[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45514329/70d4ee4c5d54c1afe5745d32d40b16ed8358cad3.jpg[/img]
[i]Only she will survive, you can spare her if you want, after all she collected all the silver spoons[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45514329/0ea3cb0735b799eacb8b20fbc807215251649650.jpg[/img]
[i]Denchik emerges from the mobster’s building[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45514329/225971ac1bc60738c357174f4d9b07543bd9f362.jpg[/img]
[i]Shootouts, because what’s a game without them...[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45514329/4904265c7771b633a8af15e90fa32634de445288.jpg[/img]
[i]You look so cool against the helicopter backdrop—then again maybe it’s all fiction and he’s actually asleep?...[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45514329/4b7b732e52eaa8081cb773991d81c2e64a321c07.jpg[/img]

[h1]Aside from the Demo Release[/h1]
We’ve been grinding for a long time and have improved the game engine [b]Nuclear Engine[/b] in every possible way:

+Added dynamic destructibility of objects—when you get out of the mobster’s basements and catacombs, try blowing up his house
+Added dismemberment for enemies, which works with any type of foes
+Adding your own weapons in two clicks
+Adding factions to bots in two clicks
+Adding destructibility to objects
+Adding bot spawners to create unexpected situations

We also added a ton of new content:
+Added new weapon LR-300
+Added mercy mechanic
+Added head-bobbing a la SAMP RP
+Added hostile factions for bots
+Added active ragdoll animations for bots
+Added head popping
+Added dynamic blood and damage indicator
+Reworked the Mojo mechanic, which will block damage if you play well
+Those very spoons

The release is close.
Very.

[b]Dwarves, prepare your wallets.[/b]

— Toxic Developer
